'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ben Paatela DS Sith Fury (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Paatela]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Sith Fury (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)|OVS14-30-Sith_Fury-remaster.webp|label=Sith Fury (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ben Pa...
* '''Deck name:''' Coruscant Mains
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
